Name: Azzy's Elf Ears for Content Patcher
Author: HarpyPunk
Description:
This is a character texture mod, originally repurposed from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11138?tab=description]Azzy's Elf Ears[/url], that adds elf ears to your farmer's sprite. You can become an real elf now by simply installing the mod (unzipping, dragging & dropping into mods folder) and loading up the game. Includes animation, which can be switched off using config..

Compatible with multiplayer as long as everyone has the same mod installed (and the same config).

Thank you to AzraelTT for making the original ear sprites!

Mods used to showcase:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Coii's Hairstyle Set Pack



[/url]
